IntegrationsCalendar export, webhooks, public API
Calendar export (.ics)
Subscribe in Outlook / Google Calendar / Apple Calendar to keep certification expiries and stale-report deadlines visible alongside your meetings.
Public API surface (read-only)
Export the report and defect data shapes as JSON so external tools can consume them. Each export is a snapshot — refresh after changes.
Audit log All recorded events
Notifications
Configure alerts, reminders and email delivery.
Alerts
Certification expiry reminders
Show a warning when any inspector's certification is within 60 days of expiry
Equipment calibration due
Notify when calibration due date is approaching
New report created
Alert when a new NDT report is added to the system
Email delivery (EmailJS)
Configure EmailJS to send real email notifications. Free tier = 200 emails/month.
Calendar export Outlook · Google Calendar · Apple Calendar
Export inspector certification expiry dates as a standard .ics file. Each cert gets two events: the expiry date itself, plus a 30-day-out reminder. Imports cleanly into any calendar app.
Webhook outbox Pipe events to your data lake, ERP, Slack, anywhere
Fire an HTTP POST to a URL of your choice when reports change stage. Useful for piping approvals into Maximo, SAP, Slack, or your own data warehouse. The receiving server must allow CORS from your origin.
